m.d: Dwight is a male given name.
A race of small people, sometime with long beards.
m.e: In Scandinavian legends dwarves are considered as a true people, different from human beings.

m.d: A very little person. A dwarf is a person whose size is much smaller than average.
m.e: She is a dwarf, only three feet (one meter) tall.

m.d: If X dwarfs Y, X is much bigger than Y.
m.e: The elephant dwarfed the people with it.

m.d: If something is dwarf is it smaller than normal. Anything of a much smaller than average size can be called dwarf..
m.e: I kept a dwarf tree in my house.

m.d: Dwayne is a male given name.
If a person dwells somewhere, they live there.
m.e: I will dwell deep in the forest.

m.d: To dwell on/upon something means to keep thinking or talking about something, especially something bad or unpleasant.
m.e: He dwelled on the problem for some time.

m.d: To dwell on/upon something means to think or talk a lot about something.
A dwelling is a building or place where someone lives.
m.e: The old house served as a dwelling for Albert.
